def log(msg: str, **kv) -> None:
    line = json.dumps({"t": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()), "msg": msg, **kv})
    with (HOME / "measure" / "measure.log").open("a") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")
    print(line, flush=True)
